---
name: 'create instructions'
agent: 'Instructions Generator'
description: 'Generates a concise agent instruction file under docs/ for one layer of architecture or one coding standard.'
---

Take the information below and write an agent instructions `.md` file for it in
the `docs/` directory. If a file name is given, use it; otherwise choose one
that describes the content. Keep the instructions concise.

Add a row for the new file to the "Read before you work" table in `AGENTS.md`.
Put the guidance itself in the new file, never in `AGENTS.md`.

If no information is given below, ask the user for the details of the layer of
architecture or coding standard to document.
